{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers AND completed status only
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion fraction: mean of `converted`
conversion_fraction = df_loyal_completed['converted'].mean()

conversion_fraction"}
